4	import { Box } from '@chakra-ui/react';
5	import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
6	import { ZimmProductCardContent } from './index';
7	import type { ZimmProductCardContentProps } from './index';
8	import type { ZimmSizeChipValue } from '../zimmSizeChipGroup';
9	
10	const SIZES: ZimmSizeChipValue[] = [
11	  { value: 'xs', label: 'XS' },
12	  { value: 's', label: 'S' },
13	  { value: 'm', label: 'M' },
14	  { value: 'l', label: 'L' },
15	];

17	const meta: Meta<typeof ZimmProductCardContent> = {
18	  title: 'Commerce/ZimmProductCardContent',
19	  component: ZimmProductCardContent,
20	  parameters: { layout: 'padded' },
21	  decorators: [
22	    // The composed product-name link renders a real react-router-dom <Link>, which requires a
23	    // Router context — same requirement and fix as zimmColourSwatch/index.stories.tsx.
24	    (Story) => (
25	      <MemoryRouter>
26	        {/* Roughly a real card's own width, matching zimmProductCardMedia/index.stories.tsx's
27	            decorator so this reads naturally as the block that sits beneath that component. */}
28	        <Box width="320px">
29	          <Story />
30	        </Box>
31	      </MemoryRouter>
32	    ),
33	  ],
34	};
35	export default meta;
36	
37	type Story = StoryObj<typeof ZimmProductCardContent>;
38	
39	/** Minimal, PLP-shaped default: name link, bag action, price — no attributes, no size chips. */
40	export const Default: Story = {
41	  args: {
42	    name: 'Natura Long Sleeve Linen Mini Dress',
43	    headingLevel: 'h3',
44	    href: '/product/123',
45	    currentPrice: '$595.00',
46	    showAttributes: false,
47	    showBag: true,
48	    onAddToBag: fn(),
49	    showSizeChips: false,
50	    showNotifyMe: false,
51	  },
52	};
53	
54	/** Wishlist-shaped: colour + size shown as plain text beneath the name. */
55	export const WithAttributes: Story = {
56	  args: {
57	    ...Default.args,
58	    showAttributes: true,
59	    colour: 'Ivory',
60	    size: 'M',
61	  },
62	};
63	
64	/** Wishlist-shaped, one-size product: the size half of the attributes line reads "One size" rather than a real size value. */
65	export const WithAttributesOneSize: Story = {
66	  args: {
67	    ...Default.args,
68	    showAttributes: true,
69	    colour: 'Ivory',
70	    size: 'One size',
71	  },
72	};
73	
74	/**
75	 * Wraps `ZimmProductCardContent` so `selectedSizeChipValue` is genuinely live rather than a
76	 * static arg — neither this component nor the `ZimmSizeChipGroup` it composes tracks selection
77	 * itself (both are correctly controlled components), so a story that wants a chip click to
78	 * visually select must own that state itself, the same pattern
79	 * zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx's `Default` story already uses via its own `DefaultExample`.
80	 * Unlike that file, `ZimmProductCardContentProps` is a single flat type, not a discriminated
81	 * union keyed by `variation` — `selectedSizeChipValue`/`onSizeChipSelect` are already valid
82	 * (optional) members on every value of the type, so `{...args, selectedSizeChipValue,
83	 * onSizeChipSelect}` needs no narrowing before it assigns back to `ZimmProductCardContentProps`,
84	 * unlike that other file's `propsWithLiveSelection`. `handleSizeChipSelect` still fires the
85	 * original `args.onSizeChipSelect` (the `fn()` spy below) so Storybook's Actions panel keeps
86	 * logging the click.
87	 */
88	const WithSizeChipsExample = (args: ZimmProductCardContentProps) => {
89	  const [selectedSizeChipValue, setSelectedSizeChipValue] = useState<string | undefined>('m');
90	  const handleSizeChipSelect = (value: string) => {
91	    setSelectedSizeChipValue(value);
92	    args.onSizeChipSelect?.(value);
93	  };
94	  return (
95	    <ZimmProductCardContent
96	      {...args}
97	      selectedSizeChipValue={selectedSizeChipValue}
98	      onSizeChipSelect={handleSizeChipSelect}
99	    />
100	  );
101	};
102	
103	/** PLP-shaped: the size-chip picker renders in place of the attributes line. Size chips are
104	 *  genuinely interactive here, not a static snapshot — starts pre-selected at 'M'; click a
105	 *  different chip to see the live selection move. Rendered via `WithSizeChipsExample` above,
106	 *  which owns `selectedSizeChipValue` as local state; every other arg below is unchanged. */
107	export const WithSizeChips: Story = {
108	  args: {
109	    ...Default.args,
110	    showSizeChips: true,
111	    sizeChipValues: SIZES,
112	    selectedSizeChipValue: 'm',
113	    onSizeChipSelect: fn(),
114	  },
115	  render: (args) => <WithSizeChipsExample {...args} />,
116	};
117	
118	/**
119	 * PLP-shaped, one-size product: triggers `ZimmSizeChipGroup`'s own `values.length === 1` branch
120	 * (see that component's `index.tsx`), which renders a single non-interactive label rather than a
121	 * `[role=radiogroup]` of chips. Plain args here, not wrapped in `WithSizeChipsExample` and with no
122	 * `selectedSizeChipValue`/`onSizeChipSelect` — there is nothing to select in that branch (it never
123	 * reaches the chip-click/keyboard-navigation code path at all), so the interactive wrapper this
124	 * file uses for `WithSizeChips` would misleadingly imply a selection state that doesn't exist here.
125	 */
126	export const WithSizeChipsOneSize: Story = {
127	  args: {
128	    ...Default.args,
129	    showSizeChips: true,
130	    sizeChipValues: [{ value: 'os', label: 'One size' }],
131	  },
132	};
133	
134	/** Out-of-stock: the bag button is present but disabled, and the notify-me CTA takes its place
135	 *  as the available action. */
136	export const Unavailable: Story = {
137	  args: {
138	    ...Default.args,
139	    isUnavailable: true,
140	    showNotifyMe: true,
141	    onNotifyMe: fn(),
142	  },
143	};
144	
145	/** A variant re-fetch in progress — ZimmProductPrice renders its own invisible placeholder,
146	 *  preserving the layout slot rather than collapsing it. */
147	export const LoadingPrice: Story = {
148	  args: {
149	    ...Default.args,
150	    currentPrice: undefined,
151	    isPriceLoading: true,
152	  },
153	};

1 import React from 'react'; 2 import { chakra, useMultiStyleConfig } from '@chakra-ui/react'; 3 import { useIntl } from 'react-intl'; 4 5 const ZIMM_PRODUCT_PRICE_RECIPE = 'ZimmProductPrice'; 6 7 /* 8 * The labels are UI copy, so they are translatable messages rather than literals. `defaultMessage` 9 * carries the English inline, which is what makes this work with no `translations/` entry: that 10 * directory is Tier 2 (owner Integration/SI Partner) and is populated by the extraction step, so 11 * a component cannot add to it. Until extraction runs, every locale renders `defaultMessage`; 12 * once it does, the non-English storefronts pick up their own strings with no change here. 13 * 14 * The ids follow the base template's namespace for PDP labels — `product_view.label.quantity` 15 * and `product_view.label.variant_type` are its siblings — so a translator finds them with the 16 * rest of the PDP copy. 17 * 18 * Placeholder syntax `{price}` lets a locale reorder the price relative to the label 19 * (e.g. German might prefer "595,00 € war" — Was after the figure). 20 */ 21 const WAS_PRICE_MESSAGE = { 22 id: 'product_view.label.was_price', 23 defaultMessage: 'Was {price}', 24 }; 25 const NOW_PRICE_MESSAGE = { 26 id: 'product_view.label.now_price', 27 defaultMessage: 'Now {price}', 28 }; 29 30 type ZimmProductPriceProps = { 31 /** 32 * The price the shopper pays today, already formatted by the caller (`intl.formatNumber` 33 * at the page). This atom does no formatting of its own so it stays usable from Storybook 34 * without an intl provider. 35 * — Full price: the only price shown. 36 * — On sale: rendered as the "Now" figure alongside `originalPrice`. 37 * 38 * Optional because the page's mapper resolves an absent price to `''` rather than to a 39 * formatted `NaN` — see `pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts`'s `selectPdpProductInfo` and 40 * the assertion it carries in `productInfo.test.ts`. That empty string reaches this atom 41 * unchanged and the decision not to render is taken here. 42 */ 43 currentPrice?: string; 44 /** 45 * The original full price before the sale, formatted the same way as `currentPrice`. 46 * When supplied the atom switches to the Was/Now sale treatment (PRC-09): 47 * "Was {originalPrice} Now {currentPrice}". Absent for full-price items. 48 */ 49 originalPrice?: string; 50 /** 51 * When true, renders an empty container instead of the price — used while a variant 52 * re-fetch is in progress to preserve the layout slot without showing stale Was/Now values. 53 */ 54 isLoading?: boolean; 55 /** 56 * Opt out of the WCAG 4.1.3 live-region announcement (`aria-live`/`aria-atomic`) entirely. 57 * Defaults to `true` so every existing caller (the PDP, where a variant swap needs to be 58 * announced) keeps today's behaviour unchanged with no code change on their end. Pass `false` 59 * when this atom is reused inside a grid of many cards (e.g. a PLP) where the price never 60 * changes after mount, so a live region adds DOM/AT overhead for no benefit — the attributes 61 * are omitted entirely in that case, not set to `aria-live="off"`. 62 */ 63 isLive?: boolean; 64 }; 65 66 /** 67 * Atom — the single, full product price. All styling, type included, lives in 68 * `zimmProductPrice.css.ts` and is consumed through the theme, per the 69 * one-canonical-styling-surface rule. Type in particular must stay there rather than on the 70 * element, or SFCC-194's `sale` variant cannot override it with a composite `textStyle` of its 71 * own — see that file's docblock. 72 * 73 * Renders nothing when there is no price, so a caller can place it unconditionally — the same 74 * contract as `ZimmProductDescription`. Rendering an empty `

` instead would still take a 75 * flex `gap` in `ZimmProductContent`'s column, leaving a hole where the price should be. 76 */ 77 export const ZimmProductPrice = ({ currentPrice, originalPrice, isLoading, isLive = true }: ZimmProductPriceProps) => { 78 // During loading, always use the sale variant so the flex row + two-span structure is rendered 79 // (invisible) — this preserves the exact Was/Now dimensions while the fetch is in flight. 80 const variant = isLoading || originalPrice ? 'sale' : 'default'; 81 82 // Guard below the hook, never above it: an early return before `useMultiStyleConfig` makes 83 // the hook call conditional, which `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` reports as an error rather 84 // than a warning. Same ordering as `ZimmProductDescription` and `ZimmProductStyleCode`. 85 const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_PRICE_RECIPE, { variant }); 86 // `intl.formatMessage`, not a destructured `{ formatMessage }`: destructuring a method off 87 // `useIntl()` trips `@typescript-eslint/unbound-method`. See `zimmProductStyleCode/index.tsx` 88 // for the established pattern and why `useUiCopy` is wrong here. 89 const intl = useIntl(); 90 91 // `isLive` gates both render paths below identically — omitted entirely when `false`, not 92 // set to `aria-live="off"`, since a card-grid reuse (SFCC-236) has no live-region need at all 93 // rather than an explicitly-disabled one. 94 const liveRegionProps: { 'aria-live'?: 'polite'; 'aria-atomic'?: 'true' } = isLive 95 ? { 'aria-live': 'polite', 'aria-atomic': 'true' } 96 : {}; 97 98 // Preserve the full Was/Now layout slot while a variant re-fetch is in progress. 99 // opacity:0 keeps the element in the flow (height + gap retained), hides the placeholder 100 // content visually, and keeps it in the accessibility tree — so AT registers the live 101 // region before the price arrives and announces the update when the fetch settles. 102 // visibility:hidden was not used: it removes the element from the AT, defeating the 103 // live-region purpose even though aria-hidden is absent. 104 if (isLoading) { 105 return ( 106 107 108 109 ); 110 } 111 112 if (!currentPrice) return null; 113 114 return ( 115 /* 116 * `aria-live`/`aria-atomic` sit on the price element itself, so this atom still renders 117 * exactly one node. 118 * 119 * WCAG 2.2 AA 4.1.3 (Status Messages) is the requirement. Choosing a variant rewrites the 120 * URL's `pid` (`pages/product-detail/index.tsx` lines 379-389), which re-keys the 121 * `useProduct` call on line 204 and hands this atom a different string. Focus never moves, 122 * so without a live region the price is repainted silently and a screen-reader user is never 123 * told the number they are buying at has changed. React mutates this element's text in 124 * place, which is exactly the change a live region reports; `aria-atomic` makes it read the 125 * whole price rather than only the characters that differ. 126 * 127 * Base `display-price/current-price.jsx` instead puts the announcement in a second, hidden 128 * node (its lines 57-66). It needs one because it prefixes a `labelForA11y` product name to 129 * order the name ahead of the price (its comment on line 56); this atom has no such prefix 130 * to order — `currentPrice` arrives already formatted and localised by the page and there is 131 * no `useIntl` here — so the extra node would carry a verbatim duplicate of the visible text. 132 * That costs twice: every screen reader would read the price twice on first load, and the 133 * extra child breaks `ZimmProductContent`'s `play` tests, which assert the exact child count 134 * of its flex column (`WithoutDescription`, `RhythmWithDescription`, `BlankDescription`). 135 */ 136 137 {originalPrice ? ( 138 <> 139 {/* PRC-09 Was/Now treatment — Figma node 40001028:9179 */} 140 141 {intl.formatMessage(WAS_PRICE_MESSAGE, { price: originalPrice })} 142 143 {/* 144 A real space so `textContent` — what a screen reader reads with aria-atomic and 145 what a shopper copies — is "Was $795.00 Now $595.00" with a separator. A 146 whitespace-only flex item adds no width (CSS Flexbox §4), so the recipe's `gap` 147 remains the only visual spacing between the spans. 148 */}{' '} 149 150 {intl.formatMessage(NOW_PRICE_MESSAGE, { price: currentPrice })} 151 152 153 ) : ( 154 currentPrice 155 )} 156 157 ); 158 }; 159

Confirmed: `ZimmProductPrice`'s own `OnSale` story uses `currentPrice: '$450.00', originalPrice: '$795.00'` — dollar sign, two decimals, `originalPrice` numerically higher than `currentPrice`. The task's suggested pair (`$416.50` / `$595.00`) matches this convention exactly (also coherently reusing `Default`'s own `$595.00` as the "was" price, ~30% off for "now"). No adjustment needed.

Let me also verify the price-prop wiring in `zimmProductCardContent/index.tsx` as a final sanity check before editing.
